disqualifier.note: Independent path classifications used as an OR include-filter; a tooling file can also be a focus file and both-false is the skip case.
Independent allow-list vs deny-list membership tests over different permission domains; a string is not expected to be in both.
Independent predicates over different inputs (path pair vs error cause).
Mutually exclusive by property count on one node, but the only joint read applies them to different handlers (onNone empty AND onSome non-empty). Not sibling flags of one stored state.

Independent match-receiver tests (O/Option vs Bool/Boolean). Combined-true is unrepresentable on one call because receivers are disjoint, but they scan independently rather than flattening one stored state.
Applied to different nodes of one ternary (condition vs branches). Empty vs single-property are exclusive by construction on one literal but are not sibling stored flags of one aggregate.
Independent prefix membership tests. A specifier can match more than one family; readers report each matching violation rather than one exclusive kind.
Independent path-family tests over one export target. Readers append a violation per matching family rather than masking a union; combined-true is legal.

Independent nested-match tests (Option vs Bool) scanned as separate rewrite candidates. Combined-true is unrepresentable on one call because receivers are disjoint, but they are not sibling stored flags.
isIgnoredPlatformTypeofComparison calls isPlatformAvailabilityGuard. Nested helper, not parallel flags of one stored state.
Sequential filters on different values: exports field object-ness then export-key spelling. Combined-true is the normal alias-building path.

docgenLaneModeForChangedPaths is a priority ternary (global then relevant then none) over free combinations. bun.lock is global-only; apps/foo/src/x.ts is relevant-only; packages/tooling/tool/docgen/src/Core.ts is both; LICENSE is neither. Combined-true is a legal path, not a masked union.
